timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹444.49 Cr (+2.6% YoY), net profit ₹92.61 Cr (-19.9% YoY).
MOIL Limited decreased prices of all manganese ore grades (Mn-44%+, below Mn-44%, SMGR, Fines, Chemical) by 4% effective midnight 30.04.2026, retaining EMD basic price ₹1,80,000.

MOIL Limited’s **Neeraj Dutt Pandey** (Company Secretary) requests NSE to waive ₹5.31L fine for non-compliance with SEBI (LODR) Regulation 17(1) due to delayed Independent Director appointments by the Ministry of Steel.
MOIL Limited received fines of ₹5,31,000 each from NSE and BSE on 27.05.2026 for board composition non-compliance.
MOIL Limited adjusted manganese ore prices: Ferro grades (≥44% Mn) down 6%, others down 5%, specific codes varied, effective midnight 31.05.2026.
MOIL and Madhya Pradesh State Mining Corporation incorporated the 51:49 JV MOIL MPSMCL Mining Limited on 04.06.2026 for manganese ore mining.
MOIL submitted consolidated details for its joint venture MOIL MPSMCL Mining Limited.
MOIL Limited fixed/revised prices of different grades of Manganese Ore effective 01.11.2026.
